source_text: Hodie ab Angelicis choris laudes divinae celebrantur, et lumen Christi adventus fidelibus illucescit. Hodie laetum nobis ver, Christus sol iustitiae affulsit, ac claro nos lumine collustravit, fideliumque mentes illuminavit. Hodie renovatur Adam, et choros cum Angelis agit, in caelum sublatus. Hodie totus terrarum orbis, gaudio ob adventum Spiritus Sancti in homines, plenus est. Hodie divina gratia, spes invisibilium effulget, et miracula quae mentem atque intelligentiam superant, mysteriumque quod ab aeterno occultatum fuit, palam nobis facit.
orientation: The preacher opens the homily by proclaiming that the mystery hidden from eternity is now made known.
pass_a_gloss: Today divine praises are celebrated by angelic choirs, and the light of the coming of Christ shines forth for the faithful. Today as a joyful spring for us Christ as sun of justice has shone, and has bathed us with bright light, and has enlightened the minds of the faithful. Today Adam is renewed, and forms choruses with the Angels, having been lifted up into heaven. Today the whole circle of lands is full with joy on account of the coming of the Holy Spirit to men. Today divine grace, the hope of unseen things, shines forth, and makes manifest to us miracles which surpass mind and understanding, and the mystery which was hidden from eternity.

choices.why: fixed glossary rendering for the divine agent coming to men
fixed glossary rendering for the divine secret hidden from eternity
literal metaphor, keeps genitive force rather than turning it into an adjective
literal dance/chorus movement shared with angels, not general rejoicing

pass_b_english: Today the angelic choirs celebrate the praises of God, and the light of Christ's coming shines upon the faithful. Today a joyful spring has dawned for us: Christ, the sun of justice, has shone upon us, bathed us in bright light, and given light to the minds of the faithful.
Today Adam is made new and forms choruses with the Angels, lifted up into heaven. Today the whole world is full of joy at the coming of the Holy Spirit among men.
Today divine grace, the hope of unseen things, shines brightly and lays open before us wonders beyond mind and understanding, and the mystery hidden from eternity.
